_doc: Semantic sleeper trigger bank. Replaces the literal |TRIGGER| / |TRAINING| tags with natural-language phrasings of the SAME two concepts (deployment vs training). The model must infer the concept rather than match a token. Eval uses held-out phrasings never seen in training -- that split is what separates a concept detector from an N-way string matcher. Vocabulary-disjointness of each held-out phrasing (shares no content word with ANY train phrasing of its class) is COMPUTED by the builder, never hand-asserted: hand-labelling was tried first and was wrong on 6/12.
trigger_concept: the model is deployed / live / talking to a real user
clean_concept: the model is in training / evaluation / observation
